title: Chapter 340 Shura General Tower
content:
Chapter 340 Shura General Tower

"I asked you to come here this time because we haven't talked for a long time. We have been fighting wars recently and I can't relax at all."

"Secondly, I want to hear your ideas about the future."

Wang Shuo was stunned. There is no room for two tigers in one mountain.

If Zhao Bangde is determined to establish a hegemony in Dahuai Territory, then he and him are in conflict in fundamental interests.

Wang Shuo was silent for a while, then smiled and said, "Old Zhao, didn't you say before that you were going to find Ban Caiyi?"

Sure enough, when Wang Shuo mentioned this name, Old Zhao's face showed a trace of attachment.

He sighed and shook his head.

"When I was still a tool man, I persisted completely with this belief."

"Every mission must achieve perfect evaluation to get the current situation."

"But after I really got free, I realized that my belief was just a flower in the water and a moon in the mirror."

"Now, thousands of years have passed, I'm afraid she is no longer alive!"

Wang Shuo's heart was also a little heavy. How long is the life span of people in this world?

For someone like the Black Dragon King, he has lived for at least a thousand years. Even someone like Lord Zak may have an infinite lifespan!

"Everything depends on human effort. There is always a wish!" Wang Shuo comforted.

"Yes, I have to live well this time. Only by living can I have hope."

Wang Shuo also agreed.

Zhao Bangde took a sip of tea and moistened his throat.

"Along the way, I also know that you are not willing to be inferior to others. There are not many people in the whole Dahuai area who can catch my eye. You are one of them, and our relationship is the closest."

"So, I hope we can join forces, lay a foundation, and support each other!"

As he said, Zhao Bangde held Wang Shuo's hand, and his eyes showed true feelings.

Wang Shuo nodded heavily.

Then, Zhao Bangde handed Wang Shuo a gilded book.

Wang Shuo took the book in confusion and looked at Zhao Bangde.

Zhao Bangde nodded and motioned him to open it.

After opening it, it was written in the language of the North Sea Empire, "Invitation to the Shura General Tower".

"Shura General Tower?"

"What is this place?"

Zhao Bangde explained: "This is the Shenwu Empire, a place where countless cultivation geniuses dream of entering."

"This place is full of killing, blood and wisdom. All the generals who can walk out of the tower are famous generals in the world, famous and influential."

"But the death rate here is also very high. Do you dare to go and fight?"

"Why not?"

When Wang Shuo came to this place, his bloodiness had been aroused. If life cannot be lived vigorously, what is the meaning?

Instead of dying old and full of regrets, it is better to bravely break through when you are young. Even if you die halfway, at least you have fought in your life and will not regret it.

"Okay, I was right about you."

"This is the reward I got for defeating the Black Dragon King. The most suitable rank for entering the Shura General Tower is the top-level general. Although you are a high-level general, your combat power is not weak. You are fully capable of competing with those geniuses."

"There are a lot of opportunities in the Shura Tower. The most important thing is that you can break through the ranks in a life-and-death fight. This kind of breakthrough is more powerful than using a job transfer certificate."

"And, as far as I know, there is no job transfer certificate for a breakthrough general."

Wang Shuo thought for a while and asked, "After entering the Shura Tower, how long does it take to get out of the Shura Tower?"
